note: Counts the interrupts of an EXTI line (Firefly_H757: line 8, PA8; Asmodee_H747: line 0, PA0; Nucleo_L4R5: line 13, PC13, the user button) and prints the counter every second. On Firefly_H757 nothing drives PA8, so the row fires the line in software through the CM4's J-Link (EXTI_SWIER1 = 0x58000008, bit 8). Built with ALLOW_HARDWARE_ACCESS_S, so it logs 'Direct hardware access permitted' on purpose.

tests.note: On Asmodee_H747 the line is EXTI 0 (PA0), fired in software through the CM4's J-Link: EXTI_SWIER1 = 0x58000008, bit 0

On Nucleo_L4R5 the line is EXTI 13, PC13, the blue user button. Firing it in software needs a write to EXTI_SWIER1 (0x40010410, bit 13) over SWD, and a hot-plug ST-Link attach to the running board was refused ('Unable to get core ID'), with bench running as well, on 2026-11-09. So the row checks that the application runs and prints its counter, not that it counts
